gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Esophageal Cancer; Radiotherapy; Magnetic Resonance Imaging; MRI; Prostate Cancer; Vulvar Cancer; Pediatric Glioblastoma Multiforme; Sarcoma
(Glioblastoma cohort) Patients with a histologically confirmed newly diagnosed intracranial glioblastoma or gliosarcoma who will be undergoing radiation therapy as part of clinical care.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] MRI IMAGING: Imaging with MRI will be performed as per disease site standards.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: (Glioblastoma cohort) Patients with a histologically confirmed newly diagnosed intracranial glioblastoma or gliosarcoma who will be undergoing radiation therapy as part of clinical care.

coder_notes: Multi-cancer serial MRI feasibility study with GBM cohorts; the only intervention is a diagnostic MRI test, so no agents. Gadolinium contrast is mentioned only conditionally in exclusion criteria, not a registered intervention (R9). Prostate cohort genomic testing and 'imaging biomarkers' are not GBM tumour molecular biomarkers for a candidate. Non-GBM cohorts include paediatric glioma; arms are all EXPERIMENTAL cohorts, none a control.
